import cv2, numpy as np

img13 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0013.png')

# Camera at px = 0.0, py = 3.366, heading = 60 deg.
th = np.radians(60)

# Stool legs in obs_0013:
# Stool is in cols 140 to 200
for c in [146, 170, 194]:
    # find bottom row
    rows = np.where(img13[:, c, 0] < 120)[0]
    print(f'c={c}: max row = {rows.max()}')

# Blue bottle/cylinder in obs_0013:
blue_mask = (img13[:, :, 0] > 150) & (img13[:, :, 2] < 50)
r_b, c_b = np.where(blue_mask)
print('Blue object row range:', r_b.min(), r_b.max())
print('Blue object col range:', c_b.min(), c_b.max())
print('Blue object center col:', c_b.mean())
"
